personal selling and sales managers have evolved from transactional selling to strategic marketing channel managers who foster symbiotic and synergic relationships with their reseller partners.

the evolution of personal selling has moved from the early era of transactional selling, through relationship selling, to the current era of strategic marketing channel management where top level sales managers are increasingly playing a prominent role as strategic channel managers.
the transition of personal sales selling and sales management through the current era has led to the emergence of strategic marketing channel management.

the evolution and transition of the personal selling and sales manager role from a tactical and transactional focus to a strategic and relationship focus in the marketing channel.
the evolution and development of the field of personal selling and management to a prominent position in strategic marketing channel relationships.

the development of the personal selling and sales literature from a historical perspective, which includes a discussion of the transition of personal sales to sales management and then to strategic marketing channel relationships.

the evolution of personal selling from a transactional selling orientation to a strategic marketing channel orientation has been a major development in the field of marketing.

the role and importance of personal selling and the sales manager has evolved from a transactional focus to the current emphasis on forging strategic partnerships/alliances between the firm and the reseller.

the discipline of personal sales and sales management is now in a position to make a major transition from a focus on transactional and relationship selling to a strategic focus on marketing channel management.

the discipline of personal sales and sales management has evolved through the years to a prominent position in the strategic management of marketing channels.
the evolution of personal selling from transactional selling to strategic channel management has been a gradual process.
the role of salespeople and sales managers has evolved over time from a focus on transactional selling to relationship selling to strategic marketing channel selling.

personal selling and sales managers have moved from being a tactical function in a firm's marketing mix to a strategic role in the firm's marketing channel management.

the evolution of the discipline of sales management from personal selling and salesperson management to a more prominent strategic role in marketing channel management is a natural extension of the historical evolution of the field.
